title: NotiVas v1.4.0
notes:
• Browser Companion Extension Bridge: Added session forwarding for canvas web login and enabled the webApp module with compose and sqlite worker support.
• Adaptive Navigation Rail: Implemented an adaptive navigation rail for wide screens across Miuix and Material interfaces.
• Cloudflare Worker Proxy: Added a cloudflare worker proxy source, wrangler configuration, and CORS proxy middleware for improved web connectivity.
• ProGuard Rules: Retained WorkManager and Room database constructors in ProGuard rules for Android stability.
• Formulas Hero Card: Aligned the formulas hero card design tokens and badge with the performance card.
